crossRefs.note: Of Mahli: Eleazar, who had no sons.
This is the thing which Yahweh commands concerning the daughters of Zelophehad, saying, ‘Let them be married to whom…

people.name: Eleazar
people.line: Son of Mahli, had no sons, only daughters

people.name: Kish
people.line: A Levite from the Merari clan

translations.web: Eleazar died, and had no sons, but daughters only: and their brothers the sons of Kish took them as wives.
translations.bsb: Eleazar died without having any sons; he had only daughters. Their cousins, the sons of Kish, married them.
translations.kjv: And Eleazar died, and had no sons, but daughters: and their brethren the sons of Kish took them.
translations.asv: And Eleazar died, and had no sons, but daughters only: and their brethren the sons of Kish took them to wife.
